GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 560 (24 Oct 46) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN - 1289)
APO 500
24 October 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repair and Refitting SS "Tsukumo Maru" ex SS "Edith Moller".
1. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to take immediate steps to repair and refit the SS "Tsukumo Maru" ex SS "Edith Moller" in order that the ship may be returned in a condition substantially similar to that at the time she came into the hands of the Imperial Japanese Government.
2. The SS "Edith Moller" is now at the part of Kure and is scheduled for repair at the Mizuno Shipyard.
3. A further memorandum directing delivery in restitution will be issued by General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, as soon as the necessary repairs, refitting and trials are satisfactorily completed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
